result:
Now I have enough to propose the fix — add the required `priority` field, matching the same convention used for `color: 'suggestion'` highlights elsewhere in the codebase (`priority: 5`).

```json
{"file": "src/packages/repl/src/screens/agentFleet/FleetView.tsx",
 "edits": [{"old": "              highlights={dispatchHighlights.map(([start, end]) => ({\n                start,\n                end,\n                color: 'suggestion',\n              }))}", "new": "              highlights={dispatchHighlights.map(([start, end]) => ({\n                start,\n                end,\n                color: 'suggestion',\n                priority: 5,\n              }))}"}],
 "patterns": [{"patron": "text-highlight-literal-missing-priority",
               "senal_del_verificador": "TS2322.*not assignable to type 'TextHighlight(\\[\\])?'.*|Property 'priority' is missing in type .* but required in type 'TextHighlight'",
               "fix_generico": "Cuando un literal se pasa como `TextHighlight` (o `TextHighlight[]`) sin el campo `priority`, añadir `priority: <n>` al literal — el valor numérico sigue la convención ya usada en el resto del árbol (PromptInput.tsx: `color: 'suggestion'` usa `priority: 5`), sin cambiar la conducta visual existente.",
```
